4th Period.weeklyDeliverable: Due Sunday night: your Block Breaker game, published, where bricks disappear when the ball hits them, plus your game link and one sentence about your rule on your portfolio site.
4th Period.workingNow: Learning the Event Handler pattern and asking Copilot to find one more pattern like it in your Block Breaker code.
4th Period.smartGoal: By the end of class, I can name the software pattern my brick code used and get Copilot to show me one more pattern like it in my code.
4th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.13 — Decompose problems and subproblems into parts to facilitate the design, implementation, and review of programs.
4th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.2 — Interacting with others in written English in various communicative forms.
agenda: Mini-lesson: what is a software pattern (5 min)
Ask Copilot question 1: which pattern is my brick code (5 min)
Ask Copilot question 2: find one more pattern (10 min)
Exit Ticket: the other pattern Copilot found (5 min)
4th Period.connections: Yesterday you made a brick disappear with a trigger and a change. Today you learn that this recipe has a name, the Event Handler pattern, and you find another one in your code. Tomorrow you play your game, find one problem, and fix it.
